notes.title: Jump straight to Basto!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Patch 3.0.5[/b][/h3]
[b]In this patch we have added an new game option to jump directly to the post game content.[/b]
[i]What does that mean?[/i]

[b]Normally[/b], to be able to [b]access [/b]the post-game content island [b]Basto [/b]you have to [b]finish [/b]the 'Experience [b]TOEM[/b]' quest before the ticket can appear in your living room.

With the [b]new [/b]start [b]game [/b]option you will start with 'Experience [b]TOEM[/b]' [b]completed[/b], all the [b]regions unlocked[/b], and you'll have [b]all [/b]the [b]items [/b][i](HikeLady, Bag, Camera, Honk, Tripod, Community Card, Album, Frames & Filters)[/i] you need for [b]Basto[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/3f907f6e6d53d800eb69baa80279048435e9d5fc.gif[/img]
(The New Adventure menu has a [b]scrollbar[/b], a [b]new option[/b] can be found at the [b]bottom[/b]!)

Due to having all of these items from the start, 'Experience TOEM' completed, and the ability to go to any region can make some sequences in the game be a bit weird, along with not being able to experience the ending sequence of the game since the quest for it already is completed.

Just something to keep in mind if you're choosing to use this option when starting a new save!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/db650cde0fd6f4f56915a64ebe34c7bcba2814dd.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Option to jump to post-game content when starting a new adventure
[/list]

[list]
[*]Nana now accepts a blurry TOEM picture
[*]Sight Photos are never counted as blurry
[/list]

notes.title: 🏝️ Free "Basto" region update!! 🏝️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/ebd8c8aa52bb01e9fb27993fc4c7e1bb79a14fde.png[/img]
[h2][b]Free Major Content Update![/b][/h2]
It's already been a whole year since TOEM's release and wowee what a journey it's been! 

We've been [b]overjoyed [/b]seeing players [b]laugh [/b]at our [b]dumb jokes[/b], squeal with [b]excitement [/b]after finding something [b]cute[/b], and of course all [b]your photos[/b]! 💖 
To [b]celebrate [/b]TOEM's [b]one year[/b] anniversary, we're [b]announcing [/b]something we've been working on for a while...🥳

The [b]free [/b]content [b]update[/b] (part 2/2) and the end of our [b]BIG update[/b] for the game!
[previewyoutube=O7N8mO84A6s;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]

[h1][b]So what is Basto?[/b][/h1]
Basto is TOEM's [b]biggest [/b]region filled with brand new content like [b]treasure hunting[/b], [b]minigames[/b], and [b]spooky stories[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/756ced2d691361363057f8b997ba8c2043b8463b.png[/img]
[i](Left to right)[/i] [b]Treasure hunting[/b], the [b]carnival[/b], and [b]spooky stories[/b] around a [b]campfire[/b].


[h3][b]How to get to Basto?[/b] 🎫[/h3]
To [b]unlock [/b]the [b]Basto [/b]region, [b]complete [/b]the [b]base game[/b] and [b]visit Nana[/b] back home in [b]Homelanda[/b]!
This update is, of course, [b]FREE[/b]!! And it's all thanks to everyone who bought the game and supported us, [b]thank you[/b]! 💖


[h3][b]1-2 hours of new content [/b] ⏰[/h3]
As any other region, there is more things to [b]explore [/b]and [b]photograph[/b]! And for most players this new [b]region [/b]will take about [b]1-2 hours[/b] to[b] 100%[/b], so it should give you plenty of more TOEM to [b]experience[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/12b1e3d8b09428058db263c343b167bfbd3e9f3c.gif[/img]
The island of [b]Basto [/b]has its own [b]special behavior[/b], which you need to find out on your own! 🛏️


[h3][b]A New Camera Attachment [/b] 🎈[/h3]
With the new [b]water popper[/b] you can interact with the world of TOEM in a whole new way, [b]splash[/b] your way into stamps and new [b]adventures[/b]! It's also kinda funny looking!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/bfd385fd8d7033297e725ccfd30f6d5599807a3e.png[/img]
Inside your camera, a [b]new button[/b] will appear once you get the water popper, giving you the option to [b]swap [/b]between launching [b]water balloons[/b] and [b]honking[/b].


[h3][b]6 Music Tracks [/b] 💿[/h3]
[b][url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/50jTMgIPZrjKFgHbCvoeRt?si=29f0TjX1Rte8KIrpsfq7-w]Jamal Green[/url][/b] & [b][url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/33em1jtdQbEvQNxOpq64l0?si=P5zbwMpYR52nt7cMo-h1ww&utm_source=copy-link]Launchable Socks[/url][/b] have knocked out some more [b]bangers [/b]for TOEM! They're so [b]amazing [/b]at what they do, and we couldn't be happier about having their [b]music [/b]in [b]TOEM[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/11372211e24c6771373222e446e9f7f16c718b71.png[/img]
[b]More [/b]music for your experience at Basto! As always you'll get the [b]cassettes [/b]when [b]unlocking [/b]new tracks so you can make [b]your [/b]own [b]playlist [/b]while playing!


[h3][b]20 Compendium Critters [/b] 🐌[/h3]
Looking for funny, cute, and interesting critters is a favorite of many, that's why we added as many [b]new compendium entries[/b] as we could!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/c2ca06584abc66070ad7a29e34f868a2e483e5b4.gif[/img]
[b]Some[/b] of the new critters are [b]not in plain sight[/b] and will take some time figuring out how to find!


[h3][b]20 More Quests [/b] ⭐[/h3]
[b]Ideas [/b]that we didn't have time to do in the base game as well as new ones, all found their way to Basto! And we hope you will have a [b]fun [/b]time checking out what we've been up to!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/a4a50bee62bdfee20955067275b0debd96881788.gif[/img]
Sometimes all you need is some [b]ice cream[/b]!


[h3][b]Bug fixes 🐛[/b][/h3]
New [b]bugs [/b]have been made, then resolved, causing old ones to appear, that we then [b]fixed[/b]! [i]We think![/i]


[hr][/hr]
We sincerely hope you [b]enjoy [/b]this update and all its [b]changes[/b].
We’re eagerly awaiting your [b]reactions [/b]on [b]social media[/b], the [b]forums[/b], or [b][url=https://discord.gg/crnKRMCAe8]Discord[/url][/b]!

[b]Hugs and kisses, 💋[/b]
[h3][b]TOEM [/b]Development Team[/h3]

notes.title: 2.0.4 Patch
notes.content:
[h2]Gooooood morning![/h2]
It's another sunny day in Karlshamn and another patch for TOEM is out!

[b]Here's a short rundown of what we've done with the game this time![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/a11469c3443530d8f4dc69706f8726dfcb57af61.png[/img]
[list]
[*]New language - Turkish! 📖
[*]New Item - Award mask! 🏆
Because TOEM won the BAFTA Debut Game category we added a celebratory item resembling the trophy that you can wear! ([b]Don't worry, it's not required for the cosplayer achievement![/b])
[*]New option - 120fps setting is now available. 🎥
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/dafeadd5459bd5ba25cd9abea11ea7054f5f1d48.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]MacOS - Not being able to take photos[/b]... In a photo game. 😳
Some older Macs seem to still have this issue and there doesn't seem to be a way to fix it. 😢
[*]MacOS - The screen turns fully magenta for a few frames while opening the camera.
[*]MacOS - Softlocks when trying to load into the game due to errors during loading of photos.
[*]Start a new game - Softlock if attempting to restart a new game if the current game has no photos taken.
[*]Localized - "Show Achievement Prompts" option is now localized again!
[*]Community Card - If your sight photos are missing from your save file, the game won't load and empty frame and soft-lock when you try to inspect it.
[*]Camera frame tutorial always appears when starting the game.
[*]Memory leak - Small leak was found when swapping photos in a picture frame.
[*]Quit - Could not press "Quit" inside the title screen if no game had been started. lol.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/db650cde0fd6f4f56915a64ebe34c7bcba2814dd.png[/img]
[list]
[*]MacOS - Uses faster scripting backend (IL2CPP) which results in the game running faster!
[*]AntiAliasing - We removed the old AA since it only affected very small parts of the world, the updated options are None, FXAA, and SMAA. (SMAA being the coolest one.)
[*]Options menu - Re-organized some settings.
[*]Preformance - Removed some unnecessary graphics calculations, TOEM should run a little faster now!
[*]Gyro - Both inspecting a photo and the map is affected by gyro now!
[*]Loading screen information when starting the game!
[/list]

notes.title: Quality Of Life Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/b0bba611cf41b8709dda23812fbc53bd447bb83a.png[/img]
[h2][b]Quality of Life Update![/b][/h2]
It’s time to release all the Quality of Life upgrades we have added to TOEM! 
Just a reminder that this is [b]part 1/2[/b] of our big update. 👀

[hr][/hr]
[h3]The [b]first time[/b] playing after downloading the patch, all your [b]photos [/b]will be [b]updated [/b]with our new compression and it can [b]take a moment[/b] to process up to 128 photos! ♻️[/h3]

[h3][b]Frames & Filters[/b] 🖼️[/h3]
You now have plenty of frames and filter to play around with when taking photos!
Just visit the [b]Photo Guild[/b] in [b]Stanhamn[/b] and talk to the new member for your [b]free[/b] upgrade!

We’re super excited to see what kind of [b]crazy photos[/b] you can take! 📸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/3feeaeecbc4752b7fa6cf8fdc7afde21b7a14dcf.gif[/img]


[h3][b]Re-stamping[/b] ⭐[/h3]
Finishing a quest and getting a stamp sure feels great, and now you can [b]re-stamp[/b] your card as many times as you want! Say goodbye to unsymmetrical stamp placements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/d5fd6ba7d0ef3cac71beba4f78907bed83783b9b.gif[/img]
In the [b]community card[/b] there is now a [b]new button[/b] in the [b]top left[/b], pressing it will lift your stamps of the card and allows you to place them again.


[h3][b]Liking/Favoriting Pictures[/b] 💖[/h3]
Make your [b]favorite[/b] picture stand out even more with the new and lovely [b]shiny foil[/b] effect added to pictures [b]you like[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/40197fc4d326633ef933740fa6418dbe7e6af189.gif[/img]
Select your pictures in the [b]album[/b], press the [b]like button[/b] and watch that [b]shine[/b]! 💖


[h3][b]Photo Quest Information 💬[/b][/h3]
Trying to remember what kind of photo a NPC wanted can sometimes be hard and that’s why this one is such a welcomed addition!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/fc8de9ae510569aa9481f106a17d26a4e59fe656.gif[/img]
A [b]box [/b]with the relevant [b]quest information[/b] can be [b]opened & closed[/b] when asked to hand in a [b]photo quest[/b]. No more need to exit the dialogue and open the community card just to refresh your memory. All compact and nice now!


[h3][b]Improved Compendium Detection 🐌[/b][/h3]
Taking a photo of certain [b]compendium critters[/b] was sometimes a bit too hard, getting the perfect angle or framing is now [b]easier[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/5f2639b4e5bcc9b69ba87782b6d4142d09196345.png[/img]
In the old method, the camera only detected a compendium when the center of the screen was inside the indicator box. But now it checks if the circle is touching any part of the indicator box!


[h3][b]Keyboard support ⌨️[/b][/h3]
There are many ways to play TOEM... and now there’s even more! Moving with [b]WASD[/b] works the same as any controller and is a very natural addition to playing with a [b]mouse[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/a1a795696ccf39dc35da8d98959935138c466ded.gif[/img]
Unfortunately, because of our UI system, only certain menus have full support for keyboard. So you will still have to use the mouse for some things! 🙇


[h3][b]New languages 📖[/b][/h3]
Feeling comfortable when playing TOEM is important to us and we hope that more people will feel at home playing in their [b]native languages[/b]. With that said, we have added these additional languages:
[list]
[*][noparse]Brazilian Portuguese [pt-BR][/noparse]
[*][noparse]Korean [ko][/noparse]
[*][noparse]Traditional Chinese [zh-TW][/noparse]
[*][noparse]Swedish [sv][/noparse]
[/list]
[h3][b]Save File Size Improvements 💾[/b][/h3]
Saving a photo takes up quite a lot of memory and was a main reason why we had a limit to the amount of photos you could take. But with this updated comes something that is super cool! We managed to reduce the file sizes by over a whooping 🥁[b] 1000%[/b] This is not a joke!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/bbd79e351212448c9a92e402d4aea531cd4b3e7a.png[/img]
As noted at the top, when starting the [b]first time[/b] all your existing [b]photos [/b]will be [b]updated[/b] and it might [b]take a moment[/b] to process up to 128 photos! ♻️

[h3][b]Miscellaneous additions[/b][/h3]
[b]Doubled Album Capacity[/b]
With the changes to the save size we have now doubled the amount of photos you can take to [b]256 photos![/b]

[b]Steam Cloud Save[/b]
Fitting right in with the smaller save size is the [b]Steam cloud save[/b] working its ✨[i]magic[/i]✨! Keeping your save synced across devices!

[b]Gamepad UI Icons[/b]
The game now detects which controller you’re using and will change the [b]UI buttons[/b] to the correct one. So if you’re playing with a [b]PlayStation[/b] controller the [b]UI[/b] will have [b]PlayStation buttons[/b]!

[b]Gyro[/b]
If you have a [b]PS5[/b] controller you can now enjoy the new gyro feature when using the camera!
Looking around has never felt more natural! In our [strike]biased[/strike] humble opinion, it feels awesome!

[b]Additional Options[/b]
Along with the new languages you can also find several new settings to tweak your experience, as well as more details about certain options.
[list]
[*] Auto save delay
[*] Music trigger delay
[*] Confined mouse
[*] Camera sensitivity 
[/list] etc.

[b]Bug fixes 🐛[/b]
We’ve also been working hard on fixing bugs, like, at least [b]4[/b].
Just take our word for it 😎

[b]Major optimizations when using the camera[/b]
If you’re playing on a low-end device or a laptop, this update will be very welcomed!! 🙂 

[hr][/hr]
We sincerely hope you enjoy this update and all its changes.
We’re eagerly awaiting your response on [b]social media[/b], the [b]forums[/b], or simply on [b]Discord[/b]!

[b]XOXO,[/b]
[h3][b]TOEM [/b]Development Team[/h3]

notes.title: TOEM's big update part 1/2 beta test!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/f1aacd1e9a4919140e404d20da19f4007993758e.png[/img]

[h3]The [b]Quality of Life[/b] changes and features we've been working on in part 1/2 of the big update to [b]TOEM[/b] are getting near completion and we want to let you try it out before it goes live and hear what you think about it![/h3]

Beta access code:
[b]GamesAreCool[/b]

[h3]⭐ We are very interested in hearing what [b]everyone[/b] thinks and feels about all the new changes! ⭐ [/h3]

[h3]Some specific things we would love to get your feedback on are:[/h3]
🖼️  The new [b]photo filters[/b]! Which is your favourite? Talk to the new npc inside the Photo Guild's house in '[b]Harbor[/b]'.
⌨️  The ability to play with [b]keyboard[/b]! Are there any features missing or unnecessary?
🎮  [b]PS5 [/b]controller gyro functionality! Let us know how it feels and fits into the game.
🐞  The camera has gotten an upgrade when detecting [b]compendium [/b]items, can you feel the difference?
🔁 [b]Restamp[/b] your community card to your hearts desire!
---------------------------------------------
🛠️  Press [b]F1 [/b]to open our dev menu.

[h3]❗ Stay safe while exploring the new features! ❗[/h3]
Since we have done a major overhaul of our save system it would be wise to go into your save folder and make a copy in the unlikely event that something break!

[h3]How to find your save folder:[/h3]
1. Press the '[b]Windows[/b]' key + '[b]R[/b]'.
2. Type in '[b]Appdata[/b]' and hit 'OK'.
3. Click on the folders: [b]LocalLow [/b]-> [b]Something [/b]We Made -> [b]TOEM [/b]and then there should be a folder named Save.
4. Copy the folder somewhere for safe keeping!
Bam! You're all set!

[h3]How to access the beta branch: [/h3]
1. Right-click [b]TOEM [/b]on Steam and click 'Properties...'
2. In the window that opens, go into 'BETAS' found on the top left side
3. Enter the code [b]GamesAreCool [/b]and press 'Check Code'
4. Press the big blue button that shows up below.
And that's it! Your Steam should now automatically download the new build! 


[b][url=https://discord.gg/hFRDY5P]Join us on discord![/url][/b]

notes.title: Big Update Announcement - Part 1/2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/dbd17573449606925bfcaba5953125d907aef99b.png[/img]
It's finally time for us to reveal what's next

TOEM is getting an update... [b]A BIG ONE! [/b]
It's even split into two parts 

Part #1 is focused on [b]Quality of Life update[/b] and is [b]coming Q1 2022[/b]. It’s meant to improve your playing experience and for that to happen we need your input on what’s missing!

[h1][b]How can you help?[/b][/h1]
Simply comment on this post!! It can be whatever, a language, a feature, as long as you think it’s missing we’ll look into it!

[h1]Here’s what we have planned[/h1]
[h2]PC[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cloud save
[*] Button Remapping (HOPEFULLY!!)
[*] Keyboard compatibility (movement, interaction, etc)
[/list]
[h2]Console[/h2]
[list]
[*] PS5 haptic feedback + adaptive triggers
[*] Switch HD Rumble (improved vibrations)
[/list]
[h2]New Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] Photomode steering sensitivity
[*] Reset all options to default
[*] Ambience music silence duration (How long it will be silent until the next song plays)
[*] Autosave interval
[*] Camera blur quality setting (Not on Switch)
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased photo capacity for all platforms
[*] Gyroscope support (PS5, Switch, and certain PC controllers)
[*] Ability to start a new game without resetting all in-game achievements
[*] Ability to re-place stamps inside the community card
[*] Kinder compendium creature detection
[*] Making more items usable from the inventory like opening the camera or placing the tripod
[*] Major performance increases across the whole game, most when using the photo mode camera
[*] Help prompt/menu when showing an NPC a photo for a quest
[/list]
----------------------------------------------------------

Thanks for reading through it all, we hope you like what we have planned for this patch.

We’re eagerly awaiting your input!!!

❗️We are accepting input until 31th of January 2022❗️

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This patch brings new and fancy upgrades to TOEM's backend system which makes loading and saving faster, everything is now done asynchronously so hick-ups have been reduced!

Along with the new backend upgrades, there are other gameplay changes and fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/a11469c3443530d8f4dc69706f8726dfcb57af61.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New backend system which improves load times by loading several files at once.
[*] System to detect and clean up photos that's not referenced in savefile but still had been created on disk
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/db650cde0fd6f4f56915a64ebe34c7bcba2814dd.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Hike Lady's shuffle and repeat buttons now toggle each other
[*] Increased bus stop sign collision box to make it easier to click on
[*] Snail moves EVEN FURTHER each time it's honked at during its snail race
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37857833/dafeadd5459bd5ba25cd9abea11ea7054f5f1d48.png[/img]
[list]
[*] "Discord" button not working
[*] Soft-lock if player took a photo and then immediately opened the album
[*] Soft-lock if player was already sitting on the bench while starting the fisherman's tune cutscene
[*] Soft-lock if player pressed "change expression" and "selfie" button. Thanks @Astotheles
[*] Pine critter triggers if you photograph them just before the stare timer is done
[*] Being able to clip into walls on the monster spotting mountain scene
[*] Pirate queen sometimes still didn't wear the correct hat
[*] The game progressively became slower and slower the more you opened the camera
[/list]

notes.title: "Help! I can't move!" hotfix!
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]

This small 6MB hotfixes to the game's navigation and a "Help! I can't move!" button inside the pause menu for those situations where you're really stuck inside things.

That said, we've noticed some issues like players getting stuck, soft-locking while talking to certain NPCs. [b]We have taken notes and while fixing it in the coming week![/b]

We're so happy seeing everyone streaming, sharing photos, and most importantly, having a good time while playing TOEM!

ALSO PLEASE LEAVE YOUR HONEST STEAM REVIEW! We want to hear what you think about TOEM ^^

-------------

### Added
- "Help! I can't move" button inside the Pause Menu
- Toggleable UI by pressing F2 F3, or F4 (three different levels of hiding with F4 hides everything)

### Fixed
- Certain navigation errors where you could get stuck in the city region
